violations.description: Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager is no longer associated with this establishment. Current manager to schedule and attend class.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Walk in cooler wire rack shelving has food / mold build up and need cleaning and sanitizing.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Lower shelving areas in kitchen have food debris build up and need cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean Floors in kitchen and walk in cooler/freezer have food/debris build up and need cleaning. Ceiling near vents has grease/dust build up and need cleaning.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Detail cleaning needed.
Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not covered or inverted during storage. Invert utensils in container at service window.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not clean. Public restrooms need cleaning.

Storage areas for refuse, recyclables, and returnables. — --The outside storage surface for holding refuse, recyclables and returnables was not constructed of nonabsorbent material and/or sloped to drain. Dumpsters stored on dirt/gravel.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors need detail cleaning under equipment & shelving units. Ceiling needs cleaning around vents.
Food service manager certification. — --Person in charge did not hold an approved food service manager certificate.
